decision: Do not promote the internal ctx.vars workaround as stable API. Carry the contract and proposal document to BMOPFTools for review and retain the bounded benchmark evidence until an upstream implementation is available.

recommended_contract.compatibility: keep set_opf_start_values!(ctx) unchanged; add the transfer overload as an additive API with a versioned return schema
recommended_contract.lifecycle: call after build_opf_model and before enforce_kcl!/optimize!; must not mutate constraints or optimize
recommended_contract.read: opf_voltage_start_values(ctx; units=:SI) -> typed bus/terminal rectangular phasors and coordinate metadata
recommended_contract.semantics: accept physical SI phasors or explicit working-coordinate values, honor per-bus voltage bases, preserve grounded terminals, and reject nonfinite or unknown bus-terminal keys
recommended_contract.write: set_opf_voltage_start_values!(ctx, starts; units=:SI) -> applied/skipped counts with validation errors
